details: Operit v1.12.0 features an extremely comprehensive ModelProvider system with 23+ distinct ApiProviderType values and 34 Kotlin files in the llmprovider package. The AIService interface unifies all providers. Two local inference backends are implemented: MNN (Alibaba's inference engine with multimodal support) and llama.cpp (GGUF local inference). StructuredToolCallBridge provides XML-to-JSON tool call conversion that works across both cloud and local providers. Configuration is stored in a dedicated DataStore with full per-model parameter control including custom parameters of any type (INT/FLOAT/BOOLEAN/STRING/OBJECT). The system supports multi-API-key rotation, per-provider rate limiting, and request concurrency control.
